scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind identify data in everyday reports.
Data: raw facts gathered for a purpose. Information: data organised to make sense.
Survey: asks people selected questions. Observation: records what someone notices. Table: arranges facts into rows and columns.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Data, Information and Survey; explain what each means.
